text:
tess.marketing: Heads up  we need two fresh battlecard variants + a one-line benchmark callout for next week's product webinar. Keep it neutral vs vendors.
priya.sales: Target: Developer-first (latency/dev workflow) and Ops-safe (SLA/reserved cost). 4 bullets each, 2 rebut lines.
sam.benchmarks: Proposed stat: "Webchat QPS60 measured: median token latency 46ms, p95 338ms on Dedicated; ~32% lower per-token cost vs default managed endpoints." Methods: web_inbound_100, open-7b vs redwood-opt-7b, 2xA100.
omar.growth: We'll A/B route: trials -> Econ-first, security-intent -> Reliability-first.
ida.sdr: SDR play: 3-step flow: qualify, AE handoff if >10k tokens/mo, nurture otherwise. Add quick objection scripts.
priya.sales: Econ bullets: "Smart batching + adaptive quantization lowers unit cost", "Prescriptive config recommendations", "Reserved pools for predictable billing", "Easy SDK integration".
priya.sales: Reliability bullets: "SLA-backed Dedicated pools", "Automatic model fallback + regional routing", "KV prefix caching tightens tail latency", "Private control plane option".
tess.marketing: QAs for webinar: econ: "We cut unit cost via batching + cache"; reliability: "Routing + fallbacks keep apps online".
sam.benchmarks: I'll produce PNG + 1-line methods footnote.
priya.sales: I'll draft the two battlecard PDFs and 6 short rebut bullets each by Wednesday.
tess.marketing: Assign owners: battlecards@priya, benches@sam, routing@omar, playbook@ida. Check-in Thursday 10am. Keep language neutral. :rocket:
